svg.title: 16.3 times more mixed throughput at the same total CPU cap
svg.desc: The original mixed workload served 382 requests per second. The optimized version served 6,221 at a combined one-CPU cap. Both used 50 virtual users for 60 seconds with one million links. Go container memory limits fell from 256 to 64 MiB. This compares limits, not measured memory usage.

g.text: 16.3× more mixed throughput. Same total CPU cap.
50 VUs · 60 seconds · 1 million links · 1 CPU across the Go servers
Replaced full-table counts with 64 transactional counters. Separated redirects from management.
Historical closed-loop comparison, not sustained arrival-rate capacity. Memory figures are configured limits.
